title: Certificates: fields, validity, revocation and the chain of trust

videos.script: A certificate is a short document with a strict format, and a client checks it line by line. {{title}} Who it names, and who signed it. {{fields}} When it starts, and when it stops. A certificate one day past its date is refused, however good it was the day before. {{validity}} Which host names it covers. Not the name on top, but the list of alternative names. {{names}} And whether its issuer has taken it back. A key that leaked is revoked, and the revocation list says so. {{revocation}} This lesson reads Vereda's certificates one field at a time, and watches each check fail for the reason it exists.
